offering_description.value: Taboola sells performance advertising to brands and agencies, placing ads across publisher sites, apps and mobile device feeds. It supplies publishers and device makers with content recommendation and monetization tools. Its commerce network connects online retailers with publishers and creators who earn commissions on referred sales.

primary_products.value: performance advertising platform; publisher content recommendation widgets; mobile content feeds; affiliate commerce platform

primary_services.value: ad campaign management and optimization; publisher ad monetization; affiliate traffic and sales generation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Brands, advertising agencies, digital publishers, mobile device makers, online retailers and content creators

end_markets.value: digital advertising; online publishing; mobile media; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: advertising: Advertisers pay for placements, typically based on clicks or impressions; commissions or management fees: Retailers pay for referred sales through the affiliate commerce network

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects publisher and device inventory with advertisers and matches retailer offers with publishers and creators; service provider: Uses campaign and referral data to optimize advertising for brands and drive sales for retailers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Middle East

specialization.value: related lines: Performance advertising, publisher recommendations and monetization, mobile content feeds and affiliate commerce

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and account teams serving advertisers, agencies, publishers and retailers; online: Self-service campaign and affiliate tools; partners / resellers: Publisher sites, apps, mobile device feeds and affiliate publishing partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Ad targeting and tracking are subject to the EU GDPR and California CCPA, among other privacy laws
